attempts.text:
This plan costs 191 and defers two adults at Likhu village.

- **Car1:** It drives Benighat shelter → Nilkantha farm → Benighat shelter (44 minutes) and rescues all three people there.
- **Car2, first trip:** It drives Dhunche hospital → Likhu village → Dhunche hospital (44 minutes) and rescues the four injured people.
- **Car2, second trip:** It drives Dhunche hospital → Likhu village → Kalika temple → Dhunche hospital (63 minutes). It carries two adults and the two elderly people from Kalika temple, which is not an evacuation point.
- **Deferred:** Two adults at Likhu village are left for a later wave, costing 40. Rescuing them would take a full extra round trip of 44 minutes to save only 40.

Total: 44 + 44 + 63 + 40 = 191.

<plan>
drive car1 benighat-shelter nilkantha-farm
load car1 injured 2
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 nilkantha-farm benighat-shelter
unload car1 injured 2
unload car1 adult 1
drive car2 dhunche-hospital likhu-village
load car2 injured 4
drive car2 likhu-village dhunche-hospital
unload car2 injured 4
drive car2 dhunche-hospital likhu-village
load car2 adult 2
drive car2 likhu-village kalika-temple
load car2 elderly 2
drive car2 kalika-temple dhunche-hospital
unload car2 adult 2
unload car2 elderly 2
defer likhu-village adult 2
</plan>
COST: 191
